items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I think I would prefer the chord style, something like a Charlie Christian style.

ctx.x: What kind of guitar did you like? Did you like chords, the lead, or picking?

Well, I didn't play with it long enough to remember myself with what style I would like. But I just liked it, period, to get there. But I think I would prefer the chord style, something like a Charlie Christian style. I see Pixie a lot too, but I read it in the chord style.
You mentioned some band was Sales, and I've forgotten which one.
